decidedBy: Claude Code (architect, D-074, D-083); two follow-ups registered by owner Ayu, coordinator unavailable, Oct 22
rules: Order is priority. Only Claude Code adds, removes or reorders tasks, except that a packet's pull request adds exactly the rows a CEO-written packet lists for it (docs/plans/D-048-phase-3-split.md, docs/plans/D-132-pricing-v2.md) and makes the dependsOn edits its note names (D-134). An agent changes only its own task's status, to done, in the pull request that lands it. Statuses: todo (pickable), in-review (a named session lands it), done, architect (any agent writes the packet first, D-109), owner (waits on the owner). A task whose dependency is not done gets no work at all until it is (D-134). Run `node scripts/next-task.mjs`.
